subject: Pricing & discount follow-up — token volumes and commit options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
Cc: Jessica Liu <jessica@aistartup.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Pricing & discount follow-up — quick next steps

Hi Samir / Jessica,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful to walk through the integration plan and expected usage. Quick recap and the asks I promised: 

- Estimated steady-state usage: you mentioned ~75M tokens/month now, with a staged launch that could reach ~200M tokens/month over the next 6 months.
- Typical run: short prompts (~20–60 tokens) with longer model completions for search/results (avg completion ~150–250 tokens).
- Main asks from your side: startup program eligibility, committed-use pricing, and multi-year incentives.

To move to an official pricing/commit proposal I need the following from you (if you can confirm in a quick reply):
1) Split of prompt vs completion tokens (approx % or numbers)
2) Desired committed monthly minimum (if any) — e.g., would you be open to a 6/12/24 month commit?
3) Target $/1M tokens you’d like us to consider for a committed plan (gives us a starting point for structure)

I’ll loop in Ben to put together committed-use tiers and the startup credit details. Attaching the Redwood startup program T&Cs and a sample commitment pricing sheet—those are drafts but should answer most questions.

Next steps: if you can reply with items 1-3 today, Ben and I will send a short proposal and a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Startup_Program_Terms.pdf

From: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Liu <jessica@aistartup.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — quick next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers below:

1) Prompt vs completion: roughly 30% prompt / 70% completion by token count (most of our calls are short prompts, but the ranking/expand paths generate the bulk of tokens).
2) Committed monthly minimum: we could consider committing to ~100M tokens/month for a 12-month term if the unit economics are right. We can scale to 200M/month by month 6 depending on product adoption.
3) Target $/1M tokens: our internal target for procurement is $45–$60 per 1M tokens (we understand list might be higher). Our current budget for initial months is ~$10k–$15k/mo; long-term we'd be looking at a higher commit.

We are a YC-backed startup (pre-Series A) and would be interested in any startup credits you offer. Also open to multi-year incentives if that helps meet the $/1M target.




—Samir
Co-founder & Head of Product
AI Startup, Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — quick next steps

Samir — got it, thanks for the detail. Helpful. A few quick clarifications before Ben builds a formal proposal:
- Can you confirm average sequence length for the 70% completion side (you mentioned ~150–250; if most are closer to 250, that changes unit cost).
- Is the $45–60/1M target a firm procurement requirement or a preferred range we should attempt to hit?

I’m looping Ben in for committed-use tiers — Ben, can you review Samir’s numbers (100M/mo commit target, growth to 200M) and propose a 12/24 month committed plan plus startup credits? If we can get within Samir’s target range with a combination of commit + startup credit + multi-year incentive, we should be able to close.

Samir / Jessica — attaching the startup T&Cs again for reference.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 17:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — committed tiers + startup credit (draft)

Hi all — looping in with a draft committed pricing structure and options. Attaching a simple pricing sheet; numbers below are list + committed discounts and illustrative target $/1M (final depends on exact token mix and seq length).

Commit tiers (monthly tokens, list $/1M, committed discount, effective $/1M):
- 0-10M: list $120 / 1M (on-demand)
- 10-50M: list $90 / 1M — 10% commit discount -> $81 / 1M
- 50-150M: list $90 / 1M — 20% commit discount -> $72 / 1M
- 150-300M: list $80 / 1M — 30% commit discount -> $56 / 1M

For Samir’s profile (100M/mo commit): baseline committed rate ~ $72 / 1M. We can layer a startup program credit (one-time or monthly credit) — typical for YC/backed pre-Series A startups is an additional 10% credit on committed spend for the first 6 months, which would bring effective $/1M down toward ~$65/1M for the initial period.

Multi-year incentives: 24-month commits can get an incremental 5-10% off the committed discount (so the 20% commit discount could become 25-30%), which would push $/1M lower (estimate mid-$50s for a 24 month lock with startup credit).

If Samir’s procurement target is $45-60, a 24-month commit + startup credit is likely the path to land squarely in that range. For 12-month commits at 100M/mo we’d be in the mid-$60s after startup credits.

Attachments: commitment_pricing_sheet.xlsx (simple model by month), sample_SOW_terms.pdf

Next steps: Marissa — if you want, I can produce a proposal with two lines: (A) 12-month, 100M/mo commit with X pricing; (B) 24-month, 100M/mo commit with deeper discounts and multi-year incentives. We’ll include a DocuSign SOW link.

Ben
Director, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Liu <jessica@aistartup.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — committed tiers + startup credit (draft)

Thanks Ben — that framing is helpful. Couple follow-ups:

- Is the startup credit applied as a monthly billing credit or as a one-time upfront credit? Prefer monthly applied credits to help our early months.
- For the 24-month option, can you outline what happens if we outgrow the commit (we expect growth to 200M/mo); is there a defined overage tier or cadence for re-negotiation?
- From a procurement perspective we do need a DocuSign-ready proposal and a short SOW that lists termination/exit terms.

If you can send a short 2-line (12 mo vs 24 mo) DocuSign package we can share with finance and legal this week.

Samir

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — committed tiers + startup credit (draft)

Samir — great questions. Quick answers and the proposed next steps: 

- Startup credit: we typically apply startup credits as monthly billing credits over the first 3-6 months (we can structure 6 months for you so it smooths initial ops).
- Outgrowth: for committed plans we include an overage tier at on-demand list (or a blended overage rate if you prefer). For 24-months we can add a re-eval clause at 12 months if growth materially exceeds projection — common language is a 90-day notice to renegotiate capacity/pricing; otherwise overage at the agreed blended rate.

Proposal (we’ll produce a DocuSign-ready package with both lines):
A) 12-month, 100M/mo commit — effective mid-$60s / 1M after 10% startup credit applied monthly.
B) 24-month, 100M/mo commit — effective mid-$50s / 1M after 24-month incentive + 10% startup credit for first 6 months. Includes re-eval clause at 12 months if monthly consumption >150% of target.

I’ll attach a draft proposal now (proposal_ai_startup_draft.pdf) and include the HubSpot deal. If that looks good to Samir/finance/legal we’ll push to DocuSign (link below once ready).

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-75642

Marissa

From: Samir Shah <samir@aistartup.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jessica Liu <jessica@aistartup.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing & discount follow-up — committed tiers + startup credit (draft)

Marissa / Ben — this looks good. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign 24-month package (option B) — we’ll have finance sign and route to legal. Request: include the monthly-applied startup credit language and the 12-month re-eval clause in the SOW.

I’ll expect the DocuSign link and we should be able to turn this around in a few days.

Thanks,
Samir
Co-founder, AI Startup, Inc.
